title: Trials and Growth
definition: Trials and growth teaches that God can use hardship to refine faith, produce endurance, deepen dependence, and mature His people.
summary: Trials are painful and should not be minimized. Yet God works through them for spiritual growth, perseverance, humility, and hope.
christFocus: Christ strengthens His people in trials and uses suffering to conform them to His likeness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Trials are painful and should not be minimized. Yet God works through them for spiritual growth, perseverance, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
